item.title: Maid-chan wa Meido-chuu
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: CloverGAME
  • 発売日: 2025-05-30
  • スコア: 6.92/10 (35 人評価)
  • 日本語名: メイドちゃんは迷途ちゅう
  • 英語名: Maid-chan wa Meido-chuu

あらすじ

Class representative Yuuki Nana is a serious and meticulous person. Seen as “scary like a demon,” she is feared at the school. Even her childhood friend Moriyama Yuuhi, who was once close to her, is now one of those who sigh at her cold attitude.

One day, Yuuhi happens to visit a maid cafe and witnesses a surprising side of Nana. The normally neat and strict Nana is now wearing a frilly maid outfit, and has transformed into an affectionate and charming girl! Yuuhi is stunned by the unimaginable transformation.

item.title: Surechigau Kyoudai no Kowareru Rinrikan
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: CloverGAME
  • 発売日: 2025-04-25
  • スコア: 6.69/10 (97 人評価)
  • 日本語名: すれ違う兄妹の壊れる倫理観
  • 英語名: Surechigau Kyoudai no Kowareru Rinrikan

あらすじ

The protagonist, Asama Sango, and the heroine, Asama Haruhi, are twin siblings.

They have been together since birth, but after enrolling in their current academy, a small misunderstanding created a rift between them. Once close, their relationship changed, and Haruhi’s attitude toward her brother Sango took a turn for the worse.

Sango, a serious-minded person, blames himself for the rift and silently endures, hoping they can return to the way they once were.

あらすじ

The protagonist, Otonashi Sumiya, and the heroine, Suzumori Mei, have known each other since childhood. Their houses are next to each other, and they have grown up together as if they were brother and sister.

But their relationship changes drastically when Mei confesses her feelings for Sumiya.

“Erotic temptation”.

She began to make sexual advances toward him at every opportunity.
